issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print both 'Actual on GAAP Basis' and 'Actual on Budgetary Basis' columns
issues.issue: Detail uses the budgetary-basis actuals, so it does not tie to the GAAP statement on p2 (e.g. General Fund Engineering 33,526 vs 37,200; Maintenance 95,912 vs 73,997; Debt Service Special Assessments 133,303 has no line on p2). This is a defensible reading of 'Actual column' and the notes say so, but a person should confirm which actual column the pipeline wants.
